content.short: 3NUM provides secure wallet-to-wallet and wallet-to-phone messaging.
content.description: 3NUM is transforming the world's largest social graph (5.5 billion mobile subscribers) into Web3. By linking phone numbers to on-chain identifiers, it creates a bridge that enables private, end-to-end encrypted messaging between wallets and phone numbers. This mapping preserves reach across traditional mobile networks while enabling secure, decentralized communication in the Web3 era. As the linkage scales, users can interact without exposing private data, supporting privacy and interoperability.
content.meta: 3NUM maps phone numbers to on-chain IDs for end-to-end encrypted messaging between wallets/phones. Discover 3NUM and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
